metasystem system · MetaSystem for this checkout: set up, start, stop, restart, status, check,
  enroll, adopt, completion

Read
  status       whether MetaSystem runs for this checkout, and its watchdog's view
  check        diagnose problems with this checkout, changing nothing

Decide
  enroll       authenticate your terminal for human decisions in MetaSystem

Work
  start        start MetaSystem for this checkout
  stop         stop MetaSystem for this checkout
  restart      stop and start MetaSystem for this checkout

Shape
  setup        set this checkout up to work with its engine: runtimes, hooks, commit fence and
               testing-contract merges
  adopt        install MetaSystem into a fresh application repository
  completion   print the shell script that makes Tab complete metasystem commands

→ metasystem system ACTION --help  one action's forms, options and examples
